# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and Vulkan expansion** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the Graphite GPU backend and expands Vulkan support, built on Skia m152. Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and backend-neutral async pixel readback, alongside several native memory-leak and performance fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152, folding in the upstream m151 stability fixes merged along the way. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds Graphite bindings for the Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, giving consumers an early path onto Skia's next-generation GPU backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **New Vulkan Silk.NET package** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and runs the Vulkan test suite on Android and Linux, broadening supported Vulkan interop options. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works consistently across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes** — Fixes use-after-free bugs in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the owning native object for the lifetime of the derived object. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on raster failure** — Fixes a leaked CoTaskMem pixel buffer when SKImage.Create fails to build a raster image. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — Uses FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, where the platform font manager is unavailable. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Platform

- **Containerized Linux/Windows test legs added** — Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and initializes the MSVC environment once per native Windows build. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz binding to 14.2.1, syncing it with the m152 Skia update and converting its solution to .slnx format.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.152.0 line, updating Skia to m152, adding the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and several native memory-leak and performance fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.1...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
